subject.title: Fix MSTeams card actions with durable receive before ACK

question: Should this external PR remain blocked until tenant-backed Microsoft Teams proof is posted, or should an authorized maintainer explicitly override the proof gate based on the SQLite lifecycle tests and SDK-contract review?
rationale: The contributor cannot access a suitable Teams tenant, while repository policy requires observed after-fix behavior for an external message-delivery PR; accepting test-only evidence therefore requires explicit maintainer ownership of the residual delivery risk.

options.title: Require tenant-backed proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a tenant holder posts redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording covering the requested normal, restart, retry, duplicate, and thread-targeting scenarios.

options.title: Grant an explicit proof override
options.body: A maintainer may accept the focused SQLite coverage and SDK-contract analysis while explicitly owning the unobserved Teams delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Require tenant-backed proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a tenant holder posts redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording covering the requested normal, restart, retry, duplicate, and thread-targeting scenarios.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the Teams monitor, conversation-reference, and proactive-send boundaries and was explicitly asked for tenant-assisted validation.
